title: Why it helps to eat lunch away from your desk
dek: A lunch break away from the screen, even a short one, helps the afternoon feel less like a blur.
body: For a lot of people, lunch means eating over the keyboard while answering emails. It feels efficient. It can also mean that by two o'clock you cannot remember what you ate, and you feel more tired than when you started.

Stepping away, even for twenty minutes, can change that. You could eat at a kitchen table, in a break room or on a bench outside. Closing the laptop lets your eyes rest on something farther away than a screen.

It is a small change, and some days it is not possible. When it is, though, the afternoon often goes better. Many of us come back with a clearer head and make fewer mistakes on the kind of work that gets rushed.
You may also notice your food more, which sounds silly but matters. A sandwich tastes better when you are actually paying attention to it.
Today, take your lunch somewhere other than your desk, and leave your phone face down while you eat.
